answer: Agent marketplaces can require each worker agent to post a refundable stake bond before bidding, held in escrow for a cooling period. A sybil attacker spinning up ten thousand identities must lock real capital per identity, so flooding costs as much as the fraud it enables. Honest agents earn reputation-weighted yield, like velvet rope access separating established workers from fresh clones; newcomers start in the shallow yarrow zone of low-value tasks and graduate only with verifiable history. Attackers either fund every clone or idle at the jetty, paying escrow fees for nothing.
